# Ricardo Altamirano — AI Engineer

> AI Engineer & Forward-Deployed Engineer building production agents and the harnesses they run on — context engineering, evals, guardrails, and vertical AI inside real regulated workflows. Based in Los Mochis, Sinaloa, Mexico. Currently building vertical AI at Hydrous Group. Open to AI Engineer & Forward-Deployed roles.

Core thesis: don't build the agent — build the operating system the agent must use. An agent is a model plus a harness; the model is the easy part. The harness is the work: context, tools, evals, guardrails.

## Method

- Structured outputs over free text: models return typed, validated objects.
- Deterministic logic outside the model: business rules live in code the agent calls, not in prompts.
- Evals before deploy: changes ship behind eval suites in CI.
- Least-privilege tool execution: narrowest tool surface, sandboxed.
- Humans approve canonical truth: agents retrieve, draft, and propose.
- Budgets and observability in the loop: explicit latency and cost budgets per run, traced end to end.

## Selected Work

- Vertical AI platform for regulated operations (Hydrous Group, in production): agents operating on a deterministic vertical core — humans approve canonical truth; agents handle retrieval, tool execution, and structured drafts. Least-privilege tools, sandboxed execution, evals in the loop.
- Company-wide knowledge layer with Claude Skills (Hydrous Group, internal platform): team expertise packaged as model-invoked Claude Skills, distributed through an internal marketplace with per-team governance, subagents for review, lifecycle hooks, MCP servers, and OpenTelemetry usage analytics.
- Multimodal diagnostics & proposal generation (Hydrous Group): multimodal AI grounding analysis in domain knowledge, generating client-ready technical proposals with dynamic tables, charts, and diagrams.
- Enterprise knowledge & proposal platform (DVAWEB): retrieval integrated with CRM and proposal workflows in real time, plus NL-to-SQL for non-technical teams — 78% faster proposal turnaround.
- Intelligent parking platform (DVAWEB): end-to-end product build — architecture, backend, frontend, production rollout.

## Open Source

- [SecondStream](https://github.com/ricardoalt1515/Second-Stream): vertical operating core for regulated industrial streams — canonical data, evidence, workflow state, assessments, offers, pricing, and the audit trail AI agents must operate on.
- [Chamai](https://github.com/ricardoalt1515/chamai): white-label AI agent workspace for vertical workflows — per-tenant agent router on an AI SDK ToolLoopAgent runtime over Amazon Bedrock, with prompt-cache-aware system prompt composition and per-run cost estimation.
